name: Decline Sit-Up
cues: Hook your feet under the pads of a decline bench
Cross your arms over your chest
Curl up one section of your spine at a time
Lower slowly until your shoulder blades touch the pad

qa.note: Wave 3b 2026-10-09: rated minor, owner review. minor: Same solution as 838 placed on the board (pelvis tilt -109 to -86, lumbar 2-18, thorax 0-24), so the trunk turns about 64 deg relative to the board and ends about 45 deg back from vertical. It reads more like a big decline crunch than a full decline sit-up. The board, roller over the ankles (feet -11.8 mm into the pad, tol 15) and foot slip 0.15 mm are fine.
